# Optional technical implementation appendix for team leads

**Post-report, on explicit request only.** The **three initial 5–10-page reports already explain** the findings, evidence, why concerns matter and what to improve. Do not defer the expert reasoning to this appendix.

Only when a team lead wants **deeper implementation-level work planning**, produce a separate Markdown document. Reuse the evidence already gathered; request additional access only for consequential gaps. For a few material evidenced findings, expand on:

- Affected service/component paths, code revisions, CI/CD run and quality-gate IDs, SonarQube report scope, OpenShift/GitOps sync and rollout traces, and operational records.
- Reproduction or further investigation steps; distinguish confirmed cause from hypotheses and competing explanations.
- Concrete engineering changes, dependencies/sequence, responsible **roles**, safety/rollback constraints, and verification/acceptance using outcomes or real control effectiveness.
- Priority and rationale tied to delivery reliability, lead time, quality or user impact. Explicitly note any missing evidence.

Do not duplicate the initial report to create pages, rerun the assessment, invent a problem list or blame people. If the initial reports already suffice, say so. This optional appendix is distinct from also-optional agent SKILL.md instructions and cannot create them implicitly. Writing into the assessed repository or executing work requires separate authorization.
